scoreBreakdown.roasExplain: ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) — revenue earned per currency unit spent on ads. 2x means every krona spent brought back 2 kr in revenue.
scoreBreakdown.ctrExplain: CTR (Click-Through Rate) — the share of people who clicked the ad out of everyone who saw it. Higher is better and suggests the ad feels relevant.
scoreBreakdown.cvrExplain: CVR (Conversion Rate) — the share of clicks that led to a purchase or goal. Shows how well the landing experience converts visitors.
scoreBreakdown.scaleExplain: Scale — how much of your budget/reach this campaign is actually using. A low value can mean the campaign is too small to get noticed.
scoreBreakdown.audienceExplain: Audience — how well the ad's targeting matches the people actually engaging with it.
